verses.translation: For the end, a Psalm of David. The fool has said in his heart, There is no God. They have corrupted themselves, and become abominable in their devices; there is none that does goodness, there is not even so much as one.

translations.ron: Zis-a cel nebun în inima sa: "Nu este Dumnezeu!" Stricatu-s-au oamenii şi urâţi s-au făcut întru îndeletnicirile lor. Nu este cel ce face bunătate, nu este până la unul.

verses.translation: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the sons of men, to see if there were any that understood, or sought after God.

translations.ron: Domnul din cer a privit peste fiii oamenilor, să vadă de este cel ce înţelege, sau cel ce caută pe Dumnezeu.

verses.translation: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become good for nothing, there is none that does good, no not one. Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips: whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness; their feet are swift to shed blood: destruction and misery are in their ways; and the way of peace they have not known: there is no fear of God before their eyes.

translations.ron: Toţi s-au abătut, împreună netrebnici s-au făcut; nu este cel ce face bunătate, nu este până la unul.

verses.translation: Will not all the workers of iniquity know, who eat up my people as they would eat bread? they have not called upon the Lord.

translations.ron: Oare, nu se vor înţelepţi toţi cei ce lucrează fărădelegea? Cei ce mănâncă pe poporul Meu ca pâinea, pe Domnul nu L-au chemat.

verses.translation: There were they alarmed with fear, where there was no fear; for God is in the righteous generation.

translations.ron: Acolo s-au temut de frică, unde nu era frică, că Dumnezeu este cu neamul drepţilor.

verses.translation: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his hope.

translations.ron: Săracul nădăjduieşte în Domnul şi voi aţi râs de nădejdea lui, zicând: Cine va da din Sion mântuire lui Israel?

verses.translation: Who will bring the salvation of Israel out of Sion? when the Lord brings back the captivity of his people, let Jacob exult, and Israel be glad.

translations.ron: Dar când va întoarce Domnul pe cei robiţi ai poporului Său, bucura-se-va Iacob şi se va veseli Israel.
